speaker: john_heminges
text: Will? John Heminges. From Aldermanbury, with a house full of boys.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: John. I heard him this morning. He croaked like a rook.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Sam Latchet has a cold in the head. On Monday he is to sing the cuckoo to the biggest house of the spring. Phillips has him by the fire with honey, and is keeping him dumb.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Dumb is right. I did not give the word to anyone else at the yard.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Arthur Meeks is learning the owl in case. He sings it as if it were a judgment.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The owl may be a judgment and the cuckoo cannot.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then the order is Sam if he can, Arthur if he must. And no word to Sam that there is an if.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No word. He will not hear it from me. If the throat is clear on Monday, he sings, and he need not know there was another boy ready.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, the fire, the honey, and the closed mouth. I will see them kept. Does the king go forward?
